hero.subheadline: Own the club. Own the upside.
hero.subdescription: The first tokenized professional football club built to compete in CONMEBOL.

vision.headline: Real land.
vision.description: Secured land in Uruguay, with a world-class sports city under construction. A professional football club competing from day one, with a 10+ year funded runway to execute with zero cash pressure.

opportunity.headline: Three pillars.
opportunity.card1Description: Uruguay produces more elite talent per capita than almost any nation on Earth. We are positioned directly at the source of that pipeline.
opportunity.card1StatLabel: Player transfer value range by tier
opportunity.card2Description: Purpose-built sports city with professional fields, gym, performance center, and analytics lab. The foundation of repeatable elite player development.
opportunity.card3Description: 20–30% of quarterly net revenue flows permanently into a Buyback & Burn pool. Every dollar of club success reduces token supply forever.

tokenomics.headline: 100M tokens.
tokenomics.buybackDescription: A minimum of 20% to a maximum of 30% of quarterly net revenue is allocated to buy PFG tokens on the open market and burn them permanently. The community votes on the exact percentage once the first player transfer occurs. All buybacks and burns are executed on-chain and auditable in real time.
tokenomics.milestoneDescription: Beyond the recurring Buyback Pool, specific operational milestones trigger fixed token burns — permanently removing supply from circulation.
tokenomics.milestoneWhyTitle: Why this matters to you as an investor
tokenomics.milestoneWhyBody: Every burn permanently reduces the total token supply. Fewer tokens in existence means each remaining token represents a larger share of the same pie. The more the club achieves — building the facility, promoting, selling players — the scarcer your tokens become. The club's success and your token's value are directly linked.
tokenomics.milestoneNote: No cash required. These 6M tokens are locked inside the smart contract from day one, taken from the Ecosystem allocation. When a milestone is verified on-chain, the contract destroys them automatically. The club spends $0 — no market purchase, no treasury expense. This is separate from the Buyback & Burn pool, which does use club revenue to buy tokens from the open market.
tokenomics.milestoneTotalSub: If all 5 milestones are hit across Phases 2–5

revenue.headline: Club profits.
revenue.year12Detail: AUF Divisional D/C — Minimal revenue. Building the foundation.
revenue.year24Detail: AUF Divisional B — ~$800K TV rights + first player transfers. Buyback Pool first activation.
revenue.year46Detail: AUF Divisional A — ~$2M TV rights + CONMEBOL bonuses + active Buyback Pool.
revenue.transfersDesc: Primary revenue driver. Uruguay's proven talent pipeline produces consistent, exportable players at every club tier — from $300K emerging clubs to $15M+ elite.
revenue.trainingDesc: 5% of all future transfer fees, paid automatically whenever a PFG-trained player moves clubs anywhere in the world. Perpetual passive income.
revenue.sellonDesc: 10–30% participation in future transfers. A $500K initial sale with a 20% clause yields $1M+ when the player sells for $5M later.
revenue.tvDesc: Divisional A: ~$2M/year. Divisional B: ~$800K/year. Structured broadcasting contracts with merit-based performance bonuses.
revenue.conmebolDesc: Copa Sudamericana: $250K–$500K+ per stage. Copa Libertadores group stage: $1M–$3M+. Compound upside as the club advances.

roadmap.headline: 5 phases.
roadmap.quote: "Execution over hype. Substance over speed. This is a 5–10 year project, not a 6-month moon shot."

team.headline: Built by operators.
team.col1Description: AUF Pro licensed coaches — the highest coaching certification in Uruguay. UEFA A and UEFA B certified, with international experience developing players who reach elite European leagues.
team.col2Description: Blockchain engineers, data analysts, and sports performance scientists. Solana-native infrastructure built and audited from the ground up.
team.col3Description: Project management, sports law, FIFA regulatory expertise, and deep international transfer market knowledge. The people who close deals.
team.philosophy: "Build for the long term, not the quick exit."

transparency.headline: Transparent
transparency.multisigDescription: In Phases 1–3, the founding team has full control over fund deployment. We are not pretending otherwise. What we commit to is complete on-chain visibility: every release, every transaction, every balance — public, auditable, and timestamped. Your protection is not a governance lock. It is radical transparency.
transparency.signers: Every release is tied to a milestone
transparency.governanceDescription: Governance is earned through milestones, not promised at launch. Each phase unlocks more community control as the club demonstrates execution.
transparency.boundaryNote: These boundaries protect competitive integrity and long-term investor value. Token holders govern the economy — experts run the club.

cta.headline: Ready to own
cta.subheadline: Three rounds. One opportunity. Limited allocation.
cta.softCapBody: Each round has its own soft cap equal to its full target. If a round does not reach its soft cap within 6 months of opening, the smart contract automatically enables every investor to reclaim their full contribution. No questions asked. The team cannot access underfunded round proceeds.
cta.softCapNote: Smart contract implementation pending audit and deployment.
cta.kycNote: Seed and Private rounds require full KYC verification and accredited investor status.
cta.restrictedNote: Not available to residents of the United States, China, Iran, Cuba, North Korea, or other OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions.
